name: Luan Loud
source:
Luan is the fourth born in the family, and tied for "most likely to become a supervillain" with my sister [url=https://vndb.org/c151349]Lisa[/url].

Let me explain a little, Luan is obsessed with jokes, puns, and comedy in general. She has her own ventriloquist dummy Mr. Coconuts she tends to take with her everywhere. Luan's dream is to one day be a big name comedian, as it is, she uses her family as a make shift audience for all her material. Normally this wouldn't be too much of a problem, while her puns tend to be groaners, her real danger is in pranks. Nothing and absolutely no one is safe or sacred when it comes to playing pranks.

April Fool's day is the worst though. That's the day she pulls out all the stops, and puts us through hell! We've tried locking her up, hiring body doubles, sending her away, you name it, and she always makes us suffer on April first!

Despite that, any other day of the year she's really nice and caring, and she'll always do her best to brighten anyone's day with a joke or silly routine. Luan also takes after [url=https://vndb.org/c151406]Dad[/url] and is a great cook. Her catch phrase is "[i]Get it?![/i]".

[In game description]
